purpose: Represent uncertainty in the 92 local registered-voter denominators without fabricating official local counts, while preserving the exact official 2026 national total and measuring whether N uncertainty is electorally material under a coherent rate-based forecast.

national_constraint.rule: Every draw contains 92 positive integers whose sum is exactly 15,801,162.

prior_centre.transformation: Scale the 92 shares to the exact 2026 national total.

innovation_scale.empirical_source: Exact normalized-name 2007->2011 local electorate-share drift; current-region labels are joined through the stable 2011/2016/2021 constituency IDs.
innovation_scale.decomposition: Estimate region-mean and within-region residual log-share dispersion from matched territories, then rescale the two components to the stable-seat-magnitude empirical dispersion reported by local_N_drift_diagnostic.json.
innovation_scale.time_scaling: Multiply four-year standard deviations by sqrt(15/4) to obtain a conservative 2011->2026 diffusion scale.
innovation_scale.distribution: Variance-standardized Student-t with 5 degrees of freedom for region and local innovations.
innovation_scale.non_claim: The diffusion scaling is a preregistered uncertainty model, not an assertion that local registration shares follow a stationary random walk.

sampling.latent_form: logistic-normal-style composition with Student-t hierarchical innovations
sampling.integerization: Allocate N-92 by largest fractional remainder after reserving one registered voter per territory; deterministic tie order by canonical constituency ID.
sampling.stored_output: Posterior summaries plus deterministic draw-matrix SHA-256; full draws are regenerated from protocol, inputs and seed rather than committed.

seat_sensitivity.principle: For a coherent forecast expressed as turnout rates and party shares, scaling N and all party vote counts proportionally leaves the quotient/remaining-seat allocation unchanged. N can affect seats only through integerization, finite-count effects or a model that aggregates territories using N weights.
tests: Exact integer scale-invariance regression on historical local and regional vectors.
Rate-based integerization sensitivity for all 92 local and 12 regional 2021 contest profiles over posterior N draws.
Report the distinct allocation count and probability of differing from the posterior-median-N reference for every contest.
seat_sensitivity.regional_policy: Regional House ballots are modelled directly at regional level; regional N is the sum of sampled local N in the region.

forbidden: Calling posterior medians official local registered-voter counts.
Using N uncertainty as an unlabelled substitute for political preference uncertainty.
Changing the seed, distribution, time scaling or gate after observing the output without issuing a new protocol version.
